from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Captures financial data for a single company's report as extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Full legal or reporting name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock market ticker or code, if available")
    period: str = Field(description="Reporting period in YYYY-MM format, e.g., 2025-01")
    
    # Metrics in RMB
    operating_revenue: Optional[float] = Field(description="Operating revenue amount (base currency)")
    net_operating_cash_flow: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net operating cash flow amount (base currency)")
    ending_monetary_funds: Optional[float] = Field(description="Ending monetary funds amount (base currency)")
    
    # Verbatim text for grounding
    operating_revenue_quote: str = Field(description="Original text snippet for operating revenue")
    net_operating_cash_flow_quote: str = Field(description="Original text snippet for net operating cash flow")
    ending_monetary_funds_quote: str = Field(description="Original text snippet for ending monetary funds")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: List[CompanyFinancialReport]
